description: baseline 100-button render benchmark before renderer changes

asi.hypothesis: establish baseline for 100-button MiniJinja Flex render path

description: skip Flex child clones when no overflow indicator exists

asi.hypothesis: Avoid cloning Flex children for the common no-OnOverflow path so layout builds less temporary tree data.

description: measure visible text width without allocating plain strings

asi.hypothesis: Compute visible width in one pass and skip ANSI escapes without allocating a temporary plain String.

description: use empty default cells and synthesize spaces only in final frame

asi.hypothesis: Avoid allocating and cloning a one-character String for untouched blank cells.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 568us to 627us despite better p50.
asi.next_action_hint: Look for width or layout scans that reduce p95 without changing cell blank representation.

description: avoid Vec allocation for one-line natural text size

asi.hypothesis: Fast-path single-line text sizing to avoid collecting split lines for labels and row text.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 568us to 639us.
asi.next_action_hint: Single-line contains scans add more cost than the avoided Vec allocation on this path.

description: blit clipped flex children without an intermediate canvas

asi.hypothesis: Avoid allocating a cropped Canvas for every visible Flex child by copying from a source offset during blit.
asi.note: Also removed the now-unused crop helper and updated the clipping test to exercise blit_from.

asi.hypothesis: Plain printable ASCII text has one cell per byte, so text_canvas can skip ANSI and unicode-width state machines for that common case.
asi.tradeoff: p99 and worst sample worsened but primary p95 improved and behavior remains generic for printable ASCII.

description: avoid final trim copy by stopping at the last non-space cell

asi.hypothesis: Build output lines only through the last non-space cell to avoid trim_end_matches plus to_string allocation.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 473us to 564us.
asi.next_action_hint: The rposition scan costs more than trimming in this workload; avoid extra row scans.

description: parse Flex markers without collecting split fields

asi.hypothesis: Avoid allocating a Vec for Flex marker fields during template tree parsing.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 473us to 485us.
asi.next_action_hint: Flex marker parsing is not the current p95 bottleneck, or the extra explicit checks offset the allocation removal.

description: skip Flex distribution when no child can grow or shrink

asi.hypothesis: Track grow and shrink eligibility while sizing children so layout skips no-op distribution scans.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 473us to 505us.
asi.next_action_hint: The extra flag bookkeeping costs more than the skipped no-op distribution scans.

description: accumulate natural Flex size without temporary vectors

asi.hypothesis: Natural size only needs sums and max values, so it can avoid collecting child sizes into a Vec.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 473us to 495us.
asi.next_action_hint: The iterator collect is not the limiting cost here; keep the clearer existing natural_size flow.

description: pass button actions by reference into text painting

asi.hypothesis: Avoid cloning the button action before text_canvas because hitbox cells already clone from the same source action.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 473us to 491us and worst latency spiked.
asi.next_action_hint: Action clone count is not a useful target for this small Action payload; focus on canvas and string work.
